guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails due to a package conflict error when installing Node.js 20 from NodeSource. The error is: "dpkg: error processing archive /var/cache/apt/archives/nodejs_20.20.2-1nodesource1_amd64.deb (--unpack): trying to overwrite '/usr/include/node/common.gypi', which is also in package libnode-dev 12.22.9~dfsg-1ubuntu3.6". This conflict likely arises because the preinstalled libnode-dev package conflicts with the Node.js installation from NodeSource. The installation process attempts to upgrade nodejs but in doing so tries to overwrite files belonging to the older libnode-dev package, causing dpkg to fail. To fix this, modify the Dockerfile to remove the conflicting libnode-dev package before installing Node.js 20 by adding a command such as `apt-get remove -y libnode-dev` before running `apt-get install -y nodejs`. Ensure that you update and clean up apt lists accordingly. This will remove the conflicting files and allow NodeSource to install Node.js 20 cleanly. Also verify that npm is installed properly after this step, as the Dockerfile installs npm twice (once via apt and once globally via npm) which might be redundant or cause version conflicts. By fixing the Node.js installation step, the environment setup will succeed and allow subsequent steps including testing to run.
